Messages.Author: Sintax
Messages.Body:
concerning the NRA rule: The vampire need only attempt to repeat the same
*type* of action to be in violation?

(EX: equip with ivory bow, freakdrive, equip with laptop. or call a vote,
freakdrive, call a different vote.)

So the list of action types looks sorta' like this?

Bleed (inherent or with card from hand)
Political Action (regardless of specific card)
Equip Action (regardless of specific card)
Recruit Ally (as above)
Hire Retainer (as above)
'Provided Action' (from a card in play)

Si?

Messages.Author: ber...@cco.caltech.edu
Messages.Body:


Also, 'Random Action' (from a card in hand) - includes all actions not
included above.

If I understand correctly, if your minion has 2 Haven Uncovered's on him,
he may burn one, untap and attempt to burn the other. However, if your
minion uses Bum's Rush to attack an opposing minion, he may not use Bum's
Rush again, but may use an Ambush, since "Attack Minion" is not an action
type. I'm not sure what rationale allows you to use the "provided action"
from more than one Haven Uncovered, but does not allow you to use the
"random action" from more than Bum's Rush, but I believe this is how it
works.

-Chris

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sintax wrote:
> concerning the NRA rule: The vampire need only attempt to repeat the same
> *type* of action to be in violation?

Correct.

> (EX: equip with ivory bow, freakdrive, equip with laptop. or call a vote,
> freakdrive, call a different vote.)

(Correct).

> So the list of action types looks sorta' like this?
>
> Bleed (inherent or with card from hand)
> Political Action (regardless of specific card)
> Equip Action (regardless of specific card)
> Recruit Ally (as above)
> Hire Retainer (as above)
> 'Provided Action' (from a card in play)

Correct, and add:
Hunt
Leave Torpor
Rescue Vampire from Torpor (regardless of target)
Encounter Vampire in Torpor to Diablerize (regardless of target)

'Provided Action' is unique for each instance of a card in play,
and for each action card by card name.
